title: Guards and Early Exit
goal: Refine pattern matches with guards and simplify unwrapping with let else.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Afternoon: Pattern Matching

sections.text: Match guards add extra `if` conditions to pattern arms. The arm matches only if the pattern matches and the guard expression evaluates to true.

sections.caption: If a guard fails, matching continues to the next arm.

sections.text: This is different from an `if` expression inside the arm body. If an arm body executes and its `if` condition fails, control does not fall through to later match arms.
When you want to bind a pattern or return early on mismatch, use `let else`. It keeps happy-path code unindented.

sections.caption: The `else` block must diverge using return, break, continue, or panic!.

explanation: Refine pattern matches with guards and simplify unwrapping with let else.
